hooks.name: Run property tests when domain logic changes
hooks.description: src/domain is pure and fully property-tested; re-run the PBT suite on every change so counterexamples surface immediately.

action.command: cmake --build --preset dev --target property_tests && ctest --preset dev -L property --output-on-failure

hooks.name: Spec task: test-first and requirement check
hooks.description: Keeps spec execution disciplined: re-read requirements and write the listed property tests before implementation.

action.prompt: Before implementing this spec task: (1) Re-read the requirement IDs referenced by the task in the spec's requirements.md and the matching Correctness Properties in design.md. (2) Confirm prerequisite tasks are complete; if not, stop and say which. (3) If the task touches src/domain, write or update the property tests (RapidCheck via Catch2, tests/property/<spec>_props.cpp, TEST_CASE named 'Property <n>: <title>', shared generators in tests/generators/) FIRST, build and run them to see them fail, then implement. (4) Keep src/domain pure: no SDL, ImGui, SQLite, curl or I/O includes. (5) Follow the glossary terms in .kiro/steering/product.md exactly.
